{"consolidated_memory":"**Multiple duplicate charge incidents in billing/webhooks/stripe.py (6 separate occasions)**

File: billing/webhooks/stripe.py (billing side)
Problem: Duplicate charge in the webhook consumer
Reproduction: Redeliver the same webhook id twice
Signal: Two ledger rows sharing one event id
Stack: Python
Test coverage: tests/billing/test_stripe_webhook.py

---

**Occasion 1 - 2026-02-11 (c024-e0): Unicode normalisation bug**
- Trigger: Only manifested on staging read replica
- Root cause: Missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- Fix: Normalised to NFC ahead of the digest (PR #1232, branch fix/duplicate-charge-1)
- Result: Alert stayed quiet for 18 consecutive days

**Occasion 2 - 2026-02-21 (c024-e1): N+1 query bug**
- Trigger: Only for deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
- Fix: Prefetched the relation in a single query (PR #1761, branch fix/duplicate-charge-2)
- Result: 70 duplicate rows a day stopped being written

**Occasion 3 - 2026-04-14 (c024-e2): Exception handling bug**
- Trigger: Only for accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- Root cause: Error swallowed by a bare except
- Fix: Narrowed the handler and let the failure propagate (PR #5441, branch fix/duplicate-charge-3)
- Result: Throughput rose 32 percent to 944 requests per second

**Occasion 4 - 2026-04-22 (c024-e3): Timezone awareness bug**
- Trigger: Only for payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Root cause: Naive datetime compared against an aware one
- Fix: Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge (PR #6976, branch fix/duplicate-charge-4)
- Result: p99 latency fell from 1.7 s to 68 ms

**Occasion 5 - 2026-06-22 (c024-e4): Mutable default argument bug**
- Trigger: Only after the client had already retried once
- Root cause: Mutable default argument shared across calls
- Fix: Made the default empty and built the value per call (PR #7740, branch fix/duplicate-charge-5)
- Result: Error rate dropped from 6.8 percent to under 6 per ten thousand

**Occasion 6 - 2026-07-17 (c024-e5): Connection pool exhaustion bug**
- Trigger: Only after a rolling restart of the fleet
- Root cause: Connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Fix: Raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it (PR #9758, branch fix/duplicate-charge-6)
- Result: Reclaimed 59 GB of blob storage"}
